_common: Photorealistic wide editorial photograph, natural daylight, shot on a full-frame camera at eye level, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, a real Southern California home. An appliance repair technician (navy polo shirt with no logo or text, work pants) is repairing a home laundry machine. The local setting must read clearly through the architecture and what is visible through the window or open door. Absolutely NO logos, brand names, badges, street signs, letters or readable text anywhere on the appliance, clothes, tools, room or outside view. Keep the left third of the frame calm and uncluttered. No watermark.
